questions.question: When did Nigeria last win the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON)?
questions.explanation:
Nigeria's Super Eagles have won the Africa Cup of Nations three times: in 1980, 1994, and most recently in 2013. In the 2013 final, they beat Burkina Faso 1-0 in South Africa, thanks to a goal from Sunday Mba.

• Option B (1994) is a trap for their second AFCON title.
• Option C (1980) is their first-ever AFCON title.
• Option D (2023) is a trap for the most recent tournament, where Nigeria were runners-up to Ivory Coast.

questions.question: Who between these two players has the most career goals?
questions.explanation:
As of late 2026, Kylian Mbappe has a higher total career goal count than Erling Haaland.

• Mbappe has surpassed 450 career goals (around 453 as of November 2026), having played significantly more matches for club and country.
• Haaland, despite his incredible scoring rate, has around 399 career goals as of November 2026, largely because he is younger and has played fewer professional matches.

While Haaland often scores at a higher goals-per-game ratio, Mbappe's longer career so far gives him the higher total number of goals.
